about_the_game:
I don’t know where I am…

There’s no one here with me.

Just a voice inside my head… urging me to keep going.

Strange symbols and letters burned into my vision.

I see a bird making sounds that echo through the emptiness…

Containers scattered everywhere.

But one thing I know for sure

I’m going to save my brother.

ABOUT

Apathic is a first-person psychological investigative horror game that pulls you into the dark secrets of the mysterious company your father once worked for.

You’ll explore surreal, distorted environments and unravel mind-bending puzzles that defy reality in your desperate search for your missing brother.

  • Manipulate gravity: Flip the world upside down to uncover hidden paths and escape deadly traps.

  • Crawl through vents and navigate container mazes deep underground: Stay one step ahead of relentless horrors in an oppressive, claustrophobic labyrinth.

Get ready for an intense atmospheric horror experience where cutting-edge technology turns our reality into a living nightmare.
